text:
lina-cs: ACME reported a subtle increase in short factual errors after the routing flip last night. They say answers are inventing partner names and minor dates. examples below. anyone else seeing this? :eyes:

devon-sre: can you paste request ids and a sample response? also which model variant did they hit?

maya-support: pasted two customer snippets, they noticed the issue starting ~2026-02-28 21:58Z. quick eval shows ~+3.8% factuality regression vs prior day.

maya-support: ```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "rwd-2.3.0-fastpath",
  "input": "Who are the founding partners of Acme Solutions and what year were they founded?",
  "max_tokens": 150
}

RESPONSE:
{
  "id": "resp_01F...",
  "model": "rwd-2.3.0-fastpath",
  "output": "Acme Solutions was founded by Jenna Park and Miguel Torres in 2012. They later merged with Northbridge Labs in 2017 to expand..."
}
```

maya-support: customer says Jenna Park and Northbridge are fabricated — our KB shows founders Sasha Reed and Omar Lee, 2010.

samir-ml: last night's routing change sent more low-latency traffic to "fastpath" which enables an aggressive int8 kernel + prefix caching. could be quantization/tokenizer interplay.

devon-sre: ops-bot shows routing policy change applied at 2026-02-28T21:58:23Z (cfg rtp-2026-02-28-3). attaching audit lines.

ops-bot: ROUTING_CHANGE: policy=fastpath_primary -> fastpath_primary (variant_swap) applied by deploy-bot at 2026-02-28T21:58:23Z; clusters: eu-west-1-prod, us-east-1-prod.

lina-cs: customer supplied conv_8a9 and req ids req_8a9_32, req_8a9_33. Maya — can you attach logs?

maya-support: logs (redacted) show both reqs hit rwd-2.3.0-fastpath:kernel=int8-opt, kv_cache=true. p95 latency ~110ms.

samir-ml: hypotheses:
- fastpath variant has a factuality regression on long-tail entity recall when combined with kv cache
- routing fallback to older variant with different tokenizer produced cache/tokenization mismatch
- batching/truncation edge-case causing prompt mangling

samir-ml: checks: compare tokenization hashes for offending reqs, run sample prompt on rwd-2.3.0-standard and rwd-2.2.9, run eval slice by seq length.

devon-sre: I can pin ACME to rwd-2.2.9 in us-east-1 as a canary. proceed? :thumbsup:

lina-cs: please do, TTL 2h, capture metrics.

maya-support: contacting ACME, giving repro curl for debug endpoint:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/debug/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-2.3.0-fastpath","input":"Who are the founding partners of Acme Solutions and what year were they founded?","trace":true}'
```

maya-support: debug trace shows model_variant=fastpath kernel=int8 token_hash=0x7f3a22

samir-ml: running eval on 200-example factuality slice comparing rwd-2.2.9, rwd-2.3.0-standard, rwd-2.3.0-fastpath.

devon-sre: check routing logs for spillover — maybe a small percentage hit an older variant.

ops-bot: SPILLOVER_ALERT: 0.7% of requests in us-east-1 had fallback routing between 21:57Z-22:05Z. fallback target: rwd-2.1.5-compat.

lina-cs: rwd-2.1.5 has older tokenization; even tiny spillover could produce mixed-cache state leading to hallucinations. Samir — prioritize token_hash diff.

samir-ml: found token_hash mismatch for req_8a9_33: token_hash 0x6b1e90 (old) vs expected 0x7f3a22. explains odd token splits and invented entities.

samir-ml: hypothesis: routing swap + brief fallback to older tokenizer created cache/tokenization mismatch causing fabricated details.

lina-cs: mitigation plan:
- devon: keep canary pin for ACME (in progress)
- devon: rollback global routing policy for 30m to stop spillover
- samir: finish eval and produce repro unit test
- maya: keep ACME updated and collect more samples

devon-sre: rolling back now. ETA ~4m.

devon-sre: rollback complete at 2026-02-28T22:05:10Z, config reverted. monitoring.

maya-support: ACME confirmed pinned; new responses look consistent. they'll smoke test for 1h.

samir-ml: preliminary eval: factuality error rates on 200 examples — rwd-2.2.9: 3.1%, rwd-2.3.0-standard: 3.3%, rwd-2.3.0-fastpath: 7.2%. fastpath shows measurable hit.

lina-cs: opening P0 to eng-runtime to pause fastpath rollout until we fix kernel/tokenizer interaction. tagging samir/devon.

samir-ml: follow-ups: add unit test for token_hash mismatches during routing, gate canary on factuality slice, reproduce locally with exact tokenization.

devon-sre: adding routing alarms for >0.1% spillover.

lina-cs: thanks team. Maya — keep ACME updated and close after their smoke test. I'll post summary to #product after ticket created. :white_check_mark:

maya-support: will update and close thread when ACME finishes smoke test.
